top_category:
(defn top_category []
  (let [spent (reduce-kv (fn [m c es]
                           (assoc m c (reduce + 0 (map (fn [e] (cents_of (get e "amount"))) es))))
                         {}
                         (group-by (fn [e] (get e "category")) (get (state) "expenses")))]
    (when (pos? (count spent))
      (first (first (sort-by (fn [e] [(- (second e)) (first e)]) (vec spent)))))))
over_budget:
(defn over_budget []
  (vec (sort (reduce-kv (fn [acc c b]
                          (if (> (spent_cents c) (cents_of b)) (conj acc c) acc))
                        []
                        (get (state) "budgets")))))
set_budget:
(defn set_budget [category amount]
  (let [m (money_of (cents_of amount))]
    (swap-state! assoc-in ["budgets" category] m)
    m))
by_category:
(defn by_category []
  (reduce-kv (fn [m c es]
               (assoc m c (money_of (reduce + 0 (map (fn [e] (cents_of (get e "amount"))) es)))))
             {}
             (group-by (fn [e] (get e "category")) (get (state) "expenses"))))
record_expense:
(defn record_expense [amount category note has_note]
  (when-not (and (number? amount) (pos? amount))
    (throw (ex-info "amount must be positive" {})))
  (when-not (and (string? category) (pos? (count category)))
    (throw (ex-info "category is required" {})))
  (when has_note
    (when-not (string? note)
      (throw (ex-info (if (nil? note) "breaks expenses-shape" "note must be text") {}))))
  (swap-state! update "expenses" (fnil conj [])
                (if has_note
                  {"amount" amount "category" category "note" note}
                  {"amount" amount "category" category}))
  (count (get (state) "expenses")))
add_expense:
(defn add_expense
  ([amount category] (record_expense amount category nil false))
  ([amount category note] (record_expense amount category note true)))
